 Gina Hinojosa holds get-out-the-vote events in Houston, Fort Bend County
 Published:  October 22, 2026 at 9:28 AM Updated:  October 22, 2026 at 11:17 AM Tags:  Gina Hinojosa , Fort Bend County Texas gubernatorial candidate Gina Hinojosa is scheduled to make three stops in the Houston area Thursday as part of her get-out-the-vote (GOTV) efforts.
 The events include early voting stops in Fort Bend County and Houston, followed by a campus visit at the University of Houston.
 Here is a look at Thursday’s scheduled events:
 8:30 a.m. – Fort Bend Early Vote Event 
 George Memorial Library, 1001 Golfview Drive, Richmond, TX 77469
 10 a.m. – Houston Early Vote Event 
 Metropolitan Multi-Service Center, 1475 W. Gray St., Houston, TX 77019
 1:15 p.m. – University of Houston Campus Stop 
 Butler Plaza at the University of Houston4333 University Drive, Houston, TX 77004
 The events are part of Hinojosa’s get-out-the-vote efforts as early voting continues in Texas ahead of the Nov. 3 general and special elections.
